Getting started: two separate identities

You have two identities: a public one with your name and photo, and an anonymous one with an ID like #a3f9 and a character that represents your discipline. No member or employer can link one to the other.
Before every post, reply, review or salary share, you choose the identity for that contribution alone.
Change your default identity from “Your account”, and renew your anonymous ID at any time.

Community: how to ask and get value
Tap + to create a post: a question or a poll.
Tap + to create a post: a question, “Take the offer?” to get colleagues’ views on an offer, a salary reveal, or a poll.
Rooms group discussions by discipline and topic (Technical Office, Site, Structural Design, MEP…) — follow what matters to you.
Reactions: “Agree” and “Disagree” can’t be combined, and “Helpful” lifts a reply up the ranking. The question’s author marks the accepted answer.
In salary discussions use “Number reply”: your figure feeds the replies’ average without being linked to your name.
Attach an image to your post — location and camera data are removed automatically before posting.
Report any content that breaks the rules with the flag icon; the community team reviews it.
Open Community
Salaries: how to read the figures and use them
The bar starts at the 10th percentile and ends at the 90th, and the glowing dot is the median: half of comparable engineers are above it and half below.
Filter by discipline and track (execution, technical office, design, consultancy…), level and governorate — every city has a factor that reflects its market.
The sample size shows next to every figure: the bigger it is, the more accurate the figure.
Share your salary anonymously (+50 points) to unlock the full details. Your individual figure is never shown to any company.
Before negotiating: place your offer on the bar, then use “Offer comparer” and “Negotiation script” from Tools.
Open Salaries
Salary visibility for company accounts
HR and employer accounts see aggregated market ranges only — no individual salary is ever shown.
Ranges for your company’s job titles appear once there are at least 30 contributions, to protect employees’ identities.
Companies & reviews
Every company has a page: reviews, salary ranges, open jobs and its public details.
You see your employees’ reviews exactly as everyone does — with nothing that reveals who wrote them.
Review your company anonymously — the review is published without your name and helps colleagues choose.
Open Companies
Jobs & applying
Post a job with precise classification (discipline, track, level and governorate are mandatory) and exact matches get an instant notification.
Track views and how many opened the contact details for each ad.
Applications happen off the platform: engineers contact you directly by email or phone.
Filter jobs by discipline, level and governorate; every ad has an estimated salary range from EngSpace.
Apply off the platform: open the contact details and send your CV directly to the employer.
Save jobs to come back to, and check your CV with the automatic reviewer before applying.
Open Jobs
Net calculator: from gross to what reaches your account after tax and social insurance.

Direct messages
Companies message engineers about a matching job, or if they turned on “Open to company messages”.
Message fellow engineers and supervisors; messaging companies isn’t available to Site Supervisor accounts.
Message colleagues freely; companies can message you only about a matching job, or if you turned on “Open to company messages”.
The identity you start a conversation with is fixed after the first message, so your two identities never meet.
You can block or report any conversation from the top of the chat.
Open Messages
Roles & permissions
Engineer: every section and every figure.
HR and employers: aggregated market ranges only, with no individual salaries.
Site Supervisor: community and messages only — no salaries and no financial figures.
Permissions map
Verification & privacy
Verification is optional: a photo of your Syndicate ID card or graduation certificate is read on your device, then deleted immediately and permanently — we never keep an ID image.
Your email and password are for signing in only, and are never shown to any member or company.
Level & points
You earn points for every contribution: a post (+5), a reply (+10), a company review (+15) and a salary share (+50).
Your level shows around your photo at the top and gives your replies more weight: Beginner → Contributor → Expert → Authority.
